title.en: Autumn Colors on the Qiao and Hua Mountains

medium.zh: 引首：紙；紙；拖尾：紙；隔水二：綾；隔水三：綾

dimensions.en: Image 28.4 × 93.2 cm; Mounting strip 1 12.3 cm; Frontispiece 28.2 × 99.6 cm; Mounting strip 2 10.9 cm; Mounting strip 3 11.1 cm; Colophons 28.4 × 320.2 cm

intro.zh: 赵孟頫卸任济南路的职务、回到南方后，为朋友周密画了这幅画；馆方定为1295年。
intro.en: Zhao Mengfu painted this for his friend Zhou Mi after heading back south from his post in the Jinan Circuit; the museum dates it to 1295.

intro.zh: 周密祖籍山东，却一直没能去过那里；这幅画为他展现了祖先故乡的风景。
intro.en: Zhou Mi's family came from Shandong, a region he had never been able to visit; the scroll shows him the landscape of his ancestral land.

intro.zh: 赵孟頫有意用古朴的画法，皴法与十世纪的董源、巨然相近。
intro.en: Zhao painted it in a deliberately archaic style, with texture strokes like those of the tenth-century masters Dong Yuan and Juran.

look_for.zh: 右边尖尖的华不注山，左边圆圆的鹊山。
look_for.en: The pointed Mount Hua(buzhu) on the right and the rounded Mount Qiao on the left.

look_for.zh: 天空中的几段题字：一段是赵孟頫自己写的，其余是18世纪乾隆皇帝后加的。
look_for.en: The blocks of writing in the sky: one by Zhao himself, the rest added in the 18th century by the Qianlong emperor.

look_for.zh: 树上点点红黄，是题目中的秋色。
look_for.en: Touches of red and yellow in the trees: the autumn colours of the title.
Cottages and trees along the marshy shore.

alt.zh: 一幅横长的设色手卷：平坦的水泽边有树木和茅屋，右边是一座尖尖的青绿山峰，左边是一座低矮的圆山。
alt.en: A wide handscroll in soft colour: flat marshland with trees and cottages, a pointed blue-green peak on the right and a low, rounded hill on the left.

image_choice.note: The painting only; the museum image is the whole scroll, with later inscriptions.

views.zh: 他在1602年记下得到这幅画的经过，后来又画了自己的版本，被后人临摹。
views.en: He recorded in 1602 how the scroll came to him as a gift, and later painted his own version of it, which other artists copied.
